appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Customize how the app looks and which sections appear in the sidebar.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose how the app looks. System matches your device setting.

sidebar.title: Sidebar sections
sidebar.description: Pick which sections appear in the sidebar.

sidebarNav.title: Sidebar navigation
sidebarNav.description: Pick which pages appear under Accounts in the sidebar navigation.

header.title: Header
header.description: Choose which header actions are visible.

currency.title: Currency symbols
currency.description: How amounts show their currency. Short symbols look like Rp, ₴ or zł instead of IDR, UAH or PLN, but currencies that share a symbol (USD, CAD, AUD, SGD) all become $.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: Choose the app's main color. Purple is the default; your choice stays on this device.
